recommendation: Support medication adherence for asthma patients
implementation_steps: Identify patients with poor medication adherence through refill history analysis
Help streamline prescription refills to ensure continuity of therapy
Support pharmacists in delivering educational interventions
Coordinate medication synchronization to simplify refill schedules
Follow up with patients who miss refills to identify and address barriers
evidence_summary: Pharmacy technician interventions supporting medication adherence have been shown to improve medication access and continuity of therapy for asthma patients, particularly when integrated into comprehensive pharmacy-based asthma management programs.
citation: Ensuring Equitable Access to Guideline-Based Asthma Care Across the Lifespan: Tips and Future Directions to the Successful Implementation of the New NAEPP 2020 Guidelines. (2023)
